name: Sireth

inventory.name: Explorer's Pack
inventory.description: Backpack, bedroll, rope, mess kit, tinderbox, torches, rations, waterskin

inventory.name: Thieves' Tools
inventory.description: Lockpicks, small file, and other tools for disarming locks

inventory.name: Folk Hero Memento
inventory.description: A trinket or token from those you helped

features_and_traits.name: Darkvision
features_and_traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

features_and_traits.name: Keen Senses
features_and_traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

features_and_traits.name: Fey Ancestry
features_and_traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features_and_traits.name: Trance
features_and_traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, you meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day.

features_and_traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
features_and_traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

features_and_traits.name: Martial Arts
features_and_traits.description: At 1st level, your practice with unarmed strikes and monk weapons gives you mastery of combat forms that use them. You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield: Your damage rolls for unarmed strikes and monk weapons increase as you gain monk levels.

features_and_traits.name: Unarmored Defense
features_and_traits.description: Beginning at 1st level, while you are unarmed or wielding only monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

features_and_traits.name: Rustic Hospitality
features_and_traits.description: You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

personality_traits: I stand up to bullies and defend the downtrodden. Even though I've escaped the Underdark, I use my skills to right injustices wherever I find them.
ideals: Community. It is each person's responsibility to improve the welfare of the place where they are.
bonds: I owe a debt to those who helped me escape the Underdark. I will help oppressed people find freedom.
flaws: I'm suspicious of those with authority and hate being told what to do. My past in the Underdark's darkness sometimes makes me paranoid.
